method: No-extra-LLM CELEUS and uniform WOR PPR EVALUE
scope: Frozen eligible benchmark pools; not future deployment-population accuracy.
resource_note: Observed active wall time and usage × assumed price only. No certified cost/time interval is computed. Independent full runs are paid separately; reported savings are protocol differences, not refunds.

celeus.assumptions: Fixed or preassignable order-independent per-item outcomes; frozen pool/prompt/model; predictable positive adaptive WOR probabilities; frozen pre-query surrogate and support; no skipped selected item. No deployment-population or API-drift guarantee.

validation_protocol.coverage_screen: one-sided exact binomial p < .01/(methods*scenarios) flags an implementation concern; passing does NOT prove coverage
validation_protocol.selection_metric: macro mean first-stop fraction; CELEUS candidates only; coverage screening first
